_comment: How an inflicted tornado climbs the tiers, dial by dial (wind-plan 4), at the sandfall's step (Jonah).
`often` (how often one comes; never more than one at once) and `size` (how wide, and so how strong, each is).
Harmful throughout: it tears up the land and throws what stands on it. Leans wet and warm, as thunderstorms do.
Needs open sky: it comes out of thunderstorms, which an Age under a ceiling never has.
